2609.02282.title: RouteGraph-Mona: Confusion-Aware Routing Fine-Tuning for Mineral Image Classification
2609.02282.paper_summary: Mineral image classification is important for geological exploration and resource development, but it remains challenging due to substantial intra-class variations in appearance and high inter-class visual similarity. Multi-cognitive Visual Adapter (Mona) is a vision-oriented parameter-efficient adapter that adapts pre-trained visual models by tuning only a few parameters. However, Mona statically aggregates responses from multiple scales, limiting its ability to accommodate sample-specific scale preferences and model confusion among visually similar mineral categories. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RouteGraph-Mona}, a lightweight route-space regularization method built on Mona. Specifically, we replace Mona's static multi-scale aggregation with sample-adaptive routing. The resulting branch-selection behavior defines a compact routing space that captures each image's scale preferences. We then regularize the resulting routing signatures with class-wise route anchors and confusion-weighted margins. The route anchors encourage class-consistent routing patterns, while the margins promote greater separation between visually similar categories in the routing space. Experiments on three public mineral image datasets with two visual backbones show that RouteGraph-Mona consistently outperforms Mona in mean accuracy and remains competitive with representative fine-tuning methods and mineral image classification baselines.
2609.02282.paper_summary_zh: 礦物影像分類對於地質勘探和資源開發非常重要，但由於外觀上的顯著類內變異和高類間視覺相似性，這項任務仍然具有挑戰性。多認知視覺適配器（Mona）是一種以視覺為導向的參數高效適配器，通過僅調整少量參數來適應預訓練的視覺模型。然而，Mona 靜態地聚合來自多個尺度的響應，限制了其適應樣本特定尺度偏好的能力，並在視覺上相似的礦物類別之間造成模型混淆。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 \textbf{RouteGraph-Mona}，這是一種基於 Mona 的輕量級路徑空間正則化方法。具體而言，我們用樣本自適應路由取代了 Mona 的靜態多尺度聚合。由此產生的分支選擇行為定義了一個緊湊的路由空間，捕捉每個影像的尺度偏好。然後，我們用類別路由錨點和混淆加權邊界來正則化生成的路由簽名。路由錨點鼓勵類別一致的路由模式，而邊界則促進在路由空間中視覺上相似類別之間的更大分離。在三個公共礦物影像數據集上進行的實驗表明，RouteGraph-Mona 在平均準確率上始終優於 Mona，並且在與代表性的微調方法和礦物影像分類基準相比時仍然具有競爭力。
